name: Keep Evil Away
overview: Scripture reveals that keeping evil away involves a deliberate commitment to trust in the Lord’s protection and to actively reject wickedness. The psalmist declares the Lord as a shepherd who provides and preserves, encouraging believers to dwell in God's presence for safety and peace. Loving the Lord leads to a hatred of evil, which results in divine preservation from harm and deliverance from the wicked. Believers are called to depart from evil, pursue peace, and refrain from envying evildoers, relying on God's sustaining power to guard their souls from all evil.
